summary: Created and corrected the complete text-only generation manifest for the authoritative 56-asset inventory. Every asset has a unique stable PNG path, explicit evidence status, architecture-led brief, LOD and projection contract, full prompt with its easter-egg rule, avoidance list, and Director-governed reference policy. No images were generated. Final independent correction audit verdict: PROMOTE.

superseded_art_report_decisions: Retained skill/ai@v1 as evidence-backed and Kaizen Metrics compatible.
Retained resume-supported VMware, MacStadium, Electron, Informatica, Atlassian, and CI/CD concepts with the inventory's placement statuses.

Created entertainment-only identity briefs for all six ACE Hardware and Column Technologies projects with explicit no-factual-architecture, no-real-campus, no-metrics, and no-skill-symbolism prohibitions.

used.name: imagegen
used.why: Applied the complete shared prompting and sample-prompt guidance to structure generation-ready stylized-concept prompts while preserving invariants and negative constraints.

prompt_contract.input_images: None by default. Same-canonical tracer PNGs may be optional style/identity references; non-tracers require an art-lead-assigned passing same-category style reference.
prompt_contract.projection: orthographic true-isometric, azimuth 225 degrees, look direction 45 degrees, elevation 35.264 degrees, roll 0
prompt_contract.sheet_layout: LOD-0, LOD-1, LOD-2, and one solid silhouette inset
prompt_contract.source_of_truth: Generated concepts are tracing and review references only; deterministic SVG and registries remain authoritative.
prompt_contract.reference_image_manifest: No raster image is currently assigned. The Director policy forbids every reference from becoming geometry or coordinate truth or transferring identity/topology.

highest_risk_briefs.art_lead_check: Overlay the generated districts against the frozen 1600 x 900 anchors and reject any coastline, centroid, or anchor drift.

highest_risk_briefs.risk: The approved name strongly attracts SAP marks, UI tables, data-flow arrows, and invented integration facts even though the brief is identity-only.
highest_risk_briefs.art_lead_check: Accept only the abstract elevated grid-deck landmark with no logo, interface, factual system cue, metric, campus implication, or skill symbolism.

highest_risk_briefs.risk: The approved name can trigger Atlassian branding, realistic data-center architecture, network diagrams, and availability implications.
highest_risk_briefs.art_lead_check: Verify that the low U-shaped fortified mass and both utility pods remain physically joined by solid ground-level service necks and contain no vendor mark, racks, topology, uptime claim, real-campus cue, or skill symbol.

highest_risk_briefs.risk: The approved name can pull generation back toward generic DevOps pipelines, delivery flows, and invented implementation facts despite the deliberately non-pipeline cairn silhouette.
highest_risk_briefs.art_lead_check: Require the four-block vertical implementation cairn, central void, five-sided podium, and off-center cap without pipeline imagery, client identity, factual architecture, delivery symbolism, or outcome claims.

highest_risk_briefs.risk: AI generation commonly falls back to brains, robots, star/sparkle silhouettes, provider logos, decision centers, or autonomy claims; this asset is supported only through the Kaizen Metrics AWS Bedrock assistant claim.
highest_risk_briefs.art_lead_check: Require the linear asymmetric horizontal calibration-drum instrument pavilion, no star/radial plan, decision chamber, brain/humanoid/provider mark, autonomy cue, or employer color baked into geometry.

unresolved_prompt_risks.risk: Mechanical text checks prove inventory and prompt distinctness, not that an image model will preserve identical primary geometry across three LOD panels.
unresolved_prompt_risks.mitigation: Use the art report's alpha-edge, projection-axis, silhouette, and deterministic traceability gates before promotion.

unresolved_prompt_risks.risk: The six identity-only project names contain brand or systems language that may pull generated output toward logos, dashboards, or invented factual architecture despite explicit negatives.
unresolved_prompt_risks.mitigation: Art lead must reject on any branding, real-campus cue, metric, skill symbolism, or factual implementation implication.

unresolved_prompt_risks.risk: No raster reference image is currently assigned. Director policy permits an optional same-canonical tracer reference or an art-lead-assigned passing same-category style reference for non-tracers.
unresolved_prompt_risks.mitigation: Treat every reference as style-only: never geometry or coordinate truth, and never transfer identity, topology, palette ownership, factual meaning, or evidence.

gates_run.name: manifest inventory, schema, count, uniqueness, path, and prompt contract
gates_run.command: $ErrorActionPreference='Stop'; $m=Get-Content -Raw -LiteralPath 'docs/career-world-production/concept-briefs.json' | ConvertFrom-Json; $inventory=Get-Content -Raw -LiteralPath 'docs/career-world-production/asset-inventory.md'; $expected=[regex]::Matches($inventory,'(?m)^(world|city|project|skill|ambient)/[a-z0-9-]+@v1(?=\s*(?:#.*)?$)') | ForEach-Object Value | Sort-Object -Unique; $actual=@($m.assets.id); $top=@('schema_version','run_id','shared_prompt','projection','palette_slots','reference_images','reference_policy','assets'); $required=@('id','category','status','evidence_status','output_path','reference_roles','asset_brief','easter_egg_rule','full_prompt','avoid'); $allowed=@('evidence-backed','identity-only','employer-supported-unlinked','user-required-unplaced','ambient'); $counts=@{world=1;city=5;project=16;skill=27;ambient=7}; foreach($f in $top){if(-not ($m.PSObject.Properties.Name -contains $f)){throw "top:$f"}}; if($m.schema_version -ne 1 -or $m.run_id -ne 'career-world-2026-07-16' -or @($m.palette_slots).Count -ne 8){throw 'top-level value'}; if($expected.Count -ne 56 -or $actual.Count -ne 56 -or ($actual|Sort-Object -Unique).Count -ne 56){throw 'id count'}; if(@(Compare-Object $expected $actual).Count){throw 'inventory mismatch'}; if((@($m.assets.output_path)|Sort-Object -Unique).Count -ne 56 -or (@($m.assets.full_prompt)|Sort-Object -Unique).Count -ne 56){throw 'path/prompt uniqueness'}; foreach($a in $m.assets){foreach($f in $required){if(-not ($a.PSObject.Properties.Name -contains $f)){throw "$($a.id):$f"}}; if($a.status -ne 'planned' -or $allowed -notcontains $a.evidence_status){throw "$($a.id):status"}; if([string]::IsNullOrWhiteSpace($a.asset_brief) -or [string]::IsNullOrWhiteSpace($a.full_prompt) -or [string]::IsNullOrWhiteSpace($a.easter_egg_rule)){throw "$($a.id):blank"}; if($a.full_prompt -notmatch 'LOD-0' -or $a.full_prompt -notmatch 'LOD-1' -or $a.full_prompt -notmatch 'LOD-2' -or $a.full_prompt -notmatch 'solid silhouette inset' -or $a.full_prompt -notmatch 'camera azimuth 225 degrees' -or $a.full_prompt -notmatch 'elevation 35.264 degrees' -or $a.full_prompt -notmatch 'Text \(verbatim\): none' -or $a.full_prompt -notmatch [regex]::Escape("Primary request: $($a.asset_brief)")){throw "$($a.id):prompt contract"}; $folder=@{world='world';city='cities';project='projects';skill='skills';ambient='ambient'}[$a.category]; if($a.output_path -notmatch "^design/career-world/concepts/$folder/[a-z0-9-]+-v1\.png$"){throw "$($a.id):path"}}; foreach($c in $counts.Keys){if(@($m.assets|Where-Object category -eq $c).Count -ne $counts[$c]){throw "$c count"}}; $ev=$m.assets|Group-Object evidence_status|Sort-Object Name|ForEach-Object{"$($_.Name)=$($_.Count)"}; "PASS total=56 ids=56 paths=56 prompts=56 categories=world:1,city:5,project:16,skill:27,ambient:7 evidence=$($ev -join ',')"

director_reference_policy.tracer_rule: Optional tracer PNGs may guide style and identity only for the same canonical asset; they never define geometry or coordinates.
director_reference_policy.non_tracer_rule: No raster by default; only the art lead may assign a passing same-category style reference.
director_reference_policy.transfer_rule: References transfer style only, never identity, topology, geometry, coordinates, palette ownership, factual meaning, or evidence.
